nodes.title: Frontend comment-assertion test sweep, first review
nodes.summary: Coverage, specification conformance, standard conformance and the whole-change captured run over the two frontend test files deleted for asserting a removed production comment's prose.

Running the full frontend suite (`npm test`) after the removals passes, with no remaining test weakened, skipped, or rewritten to tolerate comment content the removed tests used to check.
